metadata.title: Token Economics: The New Currency War of the AI Era
metadata.guest: Industry operators / founders (incl. billing & routing voices)
metadata.guest_role: AI infra · OpenRouter ecosystem · Chinese model exporters

conclusion: Silicon Valley's new flex is Token-maxxing — how many tokens and agents you burn daily. Behind the culture war over unlimited employee usage sits a pricing stack: labs, clouds, routers like OpenRouter, and billing layers like Metronome. Post-OpenClaw, agent jobs explode token spend; Chinese open models win on OpenRouter via 50–70x cheaper tokens, then ride a March 2026 China cloud price hike. Token arbitrage and 'electricity exports' via API turn Guizhou GPUs into cross-border value without shipping boxes.
background: Explainer on why giants push usage metrics, how token prices form, why MiniMax/Kimi/Zhipu caught a bid after OpenClaw, and whether cheap China tokens are durable as power and capacity tighten.
important_facts: Culture: founders rage if a $500k engineer spent only ~$5k tokens; others call raw token volume a bad KPI (Jellyfish CEO). Consensus middle: under-using AI loses. OpenClaw-class agents jump spend from 10ks to millions of tokens; Claude for tiny tasks can cost $10–20.

China angle: on some tasks US–China price gaps 50–70x; MiniMax recommended inside OpenClaw setup; Zhipu/MiniMax equities ripped as open-model calls surged. March 2026: Tencent/Alibaba/Baidu cloud AI prices up ~30% in ~10 days after open-model token demand crossed a capability threshold.

Stack: routers + agent products (Genspark/Manus) assign hard/easy tasks to minimize cost; Metronome separates usage event streams from pricing/contracts. Macro metaphor: London dev hitting MiniMax burns China grid power locally while value settles as API — 'power export' without customs. Durability of cheap tokens questioned as capacity queues appear.

mental_model.name: Usage Culture × Price Ladder × Cross-Border Token Trade
mental_model.components: Separate status games (Token-maxxing) from unit economics; map lab→cloud→router→agent margins; treat China open weights as a commodity export of electricity+compute.
mental_model.application: Watch OpenRouter share and China model ARPU after cloud hikes. Anthropic/OpenAI premium holds for hard tasks; arbitrage compresses easy tokens. Billing infra (Metronome-class) is picks-and-shovels.

key_insights.view: Tokens became corporate status and P&L at once.
key_insights.question: Is maxxing rational?
key_insights.answer: As culture maybe; as KPI often waste — but zero usage is competitive suicide.

key_insights.view: China sells cheap inference into agent demand.
key_insights.question: Why OpenRouter dominance?
key_insights.answer: Good-enough instruction following at 50–70x lower price when agents burn millions of tokens.

key_insights.view: Token export is electricity export by another name.
key_insights.question: Is the discount durable?
key_insights.answer: Only while power/capacity and open-model gaps persist; March cloud hikes are the tell.
